top_signals.title: China’s Economy Enters Critical Phase Determining 2026 Stimulus
top_signals.summary: China’s economy is moving into a period that could determine the course of stimulus through the end of the year, as consumers remain gripped by malaise despite signs of stabilizing growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
